Desarrollé ManagePoint para sustituir el sistema anterior: gestión de salones, personal, mobiliario y terminales con Laravel, permisos por roles e informes PDF.
Diseñé la base de datos y optimicé consultas para las vistas de informes.

Built the drivers' timesheet end to end: an offline-capable Flutter app, approval in Vue and a Laravel backend connected to the tachograph and payroll.
Integrated Firestore synchronisation, change history and automated tests.
Built an AI-powered nutrition app as the sole developer in four months: REST API, data model and business logic in Laravel, and the mobile app in Flutter.
Integrated nutritional analysis of photos and PDFs with Firebase AI Logic, push notifications and real-time Firestore synchronisation.
Built ManagePoint to replace the previous system: management of venues, staff, furniture and terminals with Laravel, role-based permissions and PDF reports.
Designed the database and optimised queries for reporting views.
Hardware maintenance, Linux administration and technical support.
